{{Top|leg}}
A '''power plant''' provided power and energy. The [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]] kept a [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]] operational by attaching it to power plants in the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]].
